jobs.title: Associate Product Manager (Product Operations / Business Systems)
jobs.salary: $100,000–$115,000 annual base, depending on location and experience
jobs.why: Despite the APM title, the day-to-day role centers on backlog management, requirements and acceptance criteria, Agile rituals, QA/UAT, release documentation, and translating operational user feedback into fixes. Audrey performed these tasks at Orion and has related healthcare operations exposure through Horizon Blue ABA.
jobs.gap: Employer requires direct healthcare experience; Audrey has healthcare-adjacent ABA staffing operations but not clinical care delivery, EHR or oncology workflows. Jira/Linear, live bug triage, independent retesting and product-roadmap ownership are not established.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst, Revenue Growth Platforms
jobs.location: New York, NY; hybrid minimum 4 office days/week
jobs.why: The advertising and local-media context complements Audrey's Orion reporting operations background. The role's requirements discovery, Salesforce-related enhancements, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, backlog refinement, UAT and training mirror her Salesforce BA projects.
jobs.gap: Requires 5+ years in BA/Sales Ops/RevOps/Sales Technology or related; Audrey has ~2 years 4 months formal BA and additional reporting/operations experience. Direct lead-to-revenue, prospecting, lead routing, seller workflows and programmatic ad sales technology are not documented. Four days/week on site.
missingKeywords: 5+ years dedicated BA or sales technology experience

jobs.title: Operations Analyst, Product & Engineering
jobs.location: New York City, NY; hybrid (office-day minimum not specified)
jobs.salary: $102,780–$137,040 estimated annual base; equity and discretionary bonus may apply
jobs.why: Role supports cross-functional Product and Engineering operating processes, documentation, stakeholder training, operational improvements and leadership visibility. Audrey's Orion and Horizon Blue ABA workflow automation, process mapping, reporting and cross-functional delivery are relevant.
jobs.gap: Requires 4+ years in business operations or related key functions; Audrey has broader analytics/operations tenure but less direct engineering/product operations. FinOps, cloud spend, software capitalization, and independent executive-level strategic program ownership are not demonstrated.
missingKeywords: 4+ years dedicated product or engineering operations
